title: Resolve the exact verified Tenant storage runtime snapshot through the existing route seam

phases.objective: Resolve tenantStorageRuntime from the canonical authorized dependency-injection coordinator only when the fixed mount-readback digest exposes the frozen verified dependency snapshot, while retaining the existing direct-runtime compatibility seam.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A canonical dependency-injection coordinator and the exact verified mount-readback digest
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The existing Tenant route reaches its bounded request validator only for the exact verified runtime snapshot; all missing, invalid, pre-readback, mismatched, and rolled-back states return HTTP 503.
steps: Reject a supplied object that is not the branded canonical dependency-injection coordinator.
Ask the coordinator for route dependencies using a fixed build-time mount-readback digest rather than request input.
Require a frozen dependency snapshot and a non-enumerable, non-configurable, non-writable tenantStorageRuntime descriptor.
Require the runtime to remain frozen, synthetic-only, non-provider, and non-production.
Keep the route fail-closed before injection, before readback, for missing or mismatched digests, and after rollback.
Preserve the reviewed direct tenantStorageRuntime compatibility seam without changing live server bootstrap or route registration.
assertions: The route returns storage_tenant_runtime_unavailable with HTTP 503 when no runtime source is available.
An invalid coordinator cannot fall back to a separately supplied direct runtime.
Before exact readback, the coordinator returns no route dependency and the route remains HTTP 503.
The exact readback digest resolves the same frozen runtime object from the canonical dependency snapshot.
The verified route reaches the existing bounded body validator without executing Provider work.
Rollback immediately restores HTTP 503 through per-request coordinator resolution.
No server.js, routes/index.js, migration, provider, deployment, main, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Bootstrap the reviewed coordinator and fixed readback identity through a separately governed live server composition after durable mount-state and authorization evidence exist.
Resolve coordinator state on every request so rollback and restart reconciliation change route availability without mutating the route registry or retaining a stale runtime reference.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An already built Tenant router using the canonical coordinator and exact readback digest
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: After rollback, the same route composition resolves no runtime and returns HTTP 503 without a second route registration.
steps: Build the router with the canonical coordinator and exact readback digest.
Resolve the active frozen runtime dependency per request.
Rollback the active injection using the exact readback digest.
Issue another request through the same resolver contract.
assertions: No stale runtime reference survives rollback.
No live route registry mutation is required to restore fail-closed behavior.
Worker mount, Provider dispatch, Production readiness, automatic retry, and secrets remain false.

phases.objective: Observe one separately authorized non-production server composition using durable readback identity and rollback evidence.
This route-resolution slice grants no live bootstrap, Provider, migration, deployment, main, or Production authority.
